title: JPCrypto-ISAC and SEAL sign an MOU on threat-information sharing and support for attacked firms
date_note: CoinPost gives only its publication day for the announcement.
place: Japan (country as stated by the source)
geo_basis: country of the Japanese industry body, as the source states
summary: CoinPost reports that JPCrypto-ISAC announced a memorandum of understanding with the US-based SEAL to cooperate on sharing threat information and on building support for attacked operators. JPCrypto-ISAC is to receive initial-response know-how from SEAL and is exploring a way for its members to use SEAL's incident response services.
plain: A Japanese crypto-industry security group has signed an agreement with SEAL to share threat information and help firms hit by attacks.
exec: JPCrypto-ISAC says the agreement with SEAL aims to help Japanese crypto firms detect attacks earlier and respond faster.

validation.note: Only CoinPost read; the organisations' own announcements were not read.

review.note: stronger than source: members using SEAL services is being explored per CoinPost; removed unsupported regulation tag.
